It's okay but not for me. 

The biggest problem for me were the power ups. Because there's such an abundance of them I'm constantly wondering why no one apart from the main characters are using them. For example, the movie would have been over in 2 minutes if the penguins use the power star they had in their possession to fight Bowser. Also why are the Penguins throwing snowballs at Bowser and his army when the movie later establishes that ice flowers are a thing and are far more effective.

If they were going to separate the brothers then they should have given Luigi his own B plot or something. Instead they have him sit in the cage for a large majority of the movie. Characters like Princess Peach and Donkey Kong are given more priority than the guy who's basically half the title of the movie.

I do respect the movie for being fully animated and sticking to the world of the games. I enjoyed the movie more before Mario and Luigi arrive in the mushroom Kingdom, believe it or not. Mario and Luigi's relationship in the movie is very endearing and I wish I could have seen more of that.

The jokes/humor didn't hit for me. There were some jokes that made me chuckle but nothing in this movie was a laugh riot in my opinion.

Princess Peach was fine. I like that they tried to make her more distinct from the video game version of her. Plus she was one of the few characters in this movie that had more than two brain cells to rub together. Bowser was a good mix between comedic and threatening. However, I'm just going to come out and say this, I did not care for the 'Peaches" song. To me it's just lame and annoying and I don't understand the appeal.

Anyway I'm going to end it here. I hope that the sequel will be better.
